label: End-of-episode D2 after a1 -> S1 (common), on a rewarded a1 streak
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by a common transition (100% of activations), and only in the last ten trials of the 100-trial episode (ep_trial 90-99; it never fires earlier, and value is in its lowest bin). The superset predicate D2 & a1 & S1-common & ep_trial>=90 has recall 1.0 but precision 0.13. Restricting to ep_trial>=95 with a rewarded a1 on the previous trial gives F1 about 0.55 and mass recall 0.81 on dev. Magnitude grows over consecutive a1->S1c trials and toward the episode end: in the top windows it climbs from about 0.3-0.6 to 1.0 across successive trials of a rewarded a1/S1 streak. It drops when the previous reward is 0 and does not fire after a2, S2, or rare transitions. All variables used are observed at D2 (the choice and the reached state are known by then). Precision stays incomplete: many matching late-episode a1/S1c steps are silent, so it probably reads an internal time-to-end and streak signal that the predicate only approximates.
